_doc: Release the Hounds — what each hound's ▶ Run does, in the left-sidebar order — except On the Scent (insights), first in the sidebar but run LAST: it summarises every other hound's released result (core/insights.scent_digest), so it must come after them. kind 'page': the page's run button(s) (steps) and the read requests they send — run server-side and saved as the page's cache entry, so opening the page shows the run. kind 'snapshot': the hound keeps a server snapshot — build it (the page peeks it on open). kind 'live': the page loads its own live list on open, nothing to pre-run. 'download': needs an external catalog (approval). Recorded from the pages with tools in the repo; rate_s_per_mrow = seconds per million vulns rows for the first-run estimate (measured on a 600k-finding navi.db); after a release, the measured time is used instead.

body.sql: SELECT asset_uuid, software_string FROM software WHERE software_string IS NOT NULL AND software_string<>''
SELECT asset_uuid, cpe_string FROM cpes WHERE cpe_string IS NOT NULL AND cpe_string<>''

SELECT DISTINCT asset_uuid FROM vulns WHERE lower(plugin_name) LIKE '%unsupported%' OR lower(plugin_name) LIKE '%end of life%' OR lower(plugin_name) LIKE '%end-of-life%' OR lower(plugin_name) LIKE '%no longer supported%' OR lower(plugin_name) LIKE '%obsolete%' OR lower(plugin_name) LIKE '%seol%'

SELECT asset_uuid, lower(plugin_name) pn, MAX(CASE WHEN xrefs LIKE '%CISA-KNOWN-EXPLOITED%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) kev, MAX(CASE WHEN lower(severity)='critical' OR severity='4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) crit, MAX(CAST(score AS REAL)) vpr, COUNT(*) n FROM vulns GROUP BY asset_uuid, lower(plugin_name)

excluded.acr: ACR Calibration — a live editor; changes happen by hand

excluded.contract: AI Contract — its own scheduled loop
